name: xTool M2 Color Craft Laser
tagline: Entry enclosed laser with CMYK color printing : xTool's 2026 mass-market craft machine
tldr: Launched May 2026, the M2 packs laser engraving, cutting, and integrated inkjet color printing into one enclosed desktop at $599. Built for everyday crafters and Etsy sellers who want color + laser without a pro CO₂ budget : not a metal-marking or production cutter.
mainObjective: Affordable enclosed laser + color print for home crafters and small shops

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cannot: LightBurn workflow (xTool app only at launch)

pros: 10W on xTool M2 Color Craft Laser: engraving-first : photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Integrated cabinet helps contain the beam and everyday smoke versus open-frame diodes
Software on the profile : trial your workflow on scrap before production
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone

primaryUse: 2026 entry enclosed craft system combining diode laser work with integrated color printing for gifts and small business.

editorialDepth.advantages: xTool M2 Color Craft Laser 10W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Enclosed format is easier to live with at home.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 3 mm+ cutting in production. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
